name: WordPress Privacy Lint (GDPR / DSGVO)
subtitle: Finds the 12 author-side privacy duties your plugin PHP breaks, with the article and the fix on every line.
free: Audits the PHP file you have open against all 12 author-side GDPR/DSGVO rules and names the article and the fix for every hit.
paid: Scans every PHP file in the whole plugin in one run and writes a dated audit report you keep (Markdown and JSON) for the WordPress.org review reply and your Art. 30 records.
need_key: This option needs a licence (WordPress Privacy Lint (GDPR / DSGVO)).
